metadata.name: Clockwork
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A duel inside a giant clock tower. A brass pendulum the size of a car swings through the middle of the shaft, across the bridge where the armour waits, and runs over anyone it meets mid-swing. Gear lifts tick up the shaft, the clock room's window bay is the sniper perch behind the clock face, and every minute the clock strikes: the bell hammers come down in the belfry, every light flashes and the boom rolls four times.

do.text: Clockwork: mind the pendulum. On the hour the bell hammers come down.

rules.name: The hour strikes: hammers and the boom
The hour strikes: every light flashes
